answer: An agent economy can require every identity to lock a scarce token as collateral before it may submit jobs or claim rewards. If several identities coordinate, each must lock its own stake, so splitting one actor into a swarm does not create free influence. After a verified fraud report, a contract can slash the offending stake and pay part to the reporter. The attacker therefore risks real capital for each sybil, while honest agents recover collateral; zenith, onyx, and voyage can simply be distinct registered agents under the same rule.
